title: ADR-0053 Phase 2 · Slice 5: timezone-aware analytics date bucketing
body:
**Part of ADR-0053 Phase 2.** Design: #1975 · Parent: #1928.

**Slice 5 of 6 — compute-tz, highest risk (dialect).** Make analytics date bucketing timezone-aware.

### Decision D2 (see #1975)
Bucket **in-memory (JS), uniformly**; do **not** emit dialect-specific `date_trunc … AT TIME ZONE`. SQLite has no tz database and MySQL needs tz tables loaded → splitting by dialect produces different bucket boundaries for the same data (a correctness landmine the sqlite-heavy test matrix wouldn't catch).

### Scope
- Swap `getUTC*` for the shared `partsInTz` util (from slice 3) in:
  - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-evaluator.ts:69-89` (`bucketDate`)
  - `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts:64-87` (`formatDateBucket`)
- Feed the reference tz through the dataset query — the seam already exists (hard-coded `'UTC'`): `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts:264` and `:317`.
- Keep the DB-side UTC fast path when reference tz is unset or `'UTC'`; still push the date-range **filter** to the DB, only bucket in memory when tz ≠ UTC — `objectql-strategy.ts:29-52`.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Day/week/month/quarter buckets align to the reference tz, identically on SQLite and Postgres.
- [ ] tz unset / `'UTC'` → DB-side fast path, behavior unchanged.
- [ ] Test: a row near a tz day-boundary lands in the correct bucket under a non-UTC reference tz.

### Depends on
Slices 1 (timezone) and 3 (shared `partsInTz` util).
